description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the MonitorExamination operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的线上监考MonitorExamination的语法及示例
name: MonitorExamination

parameters.help_en:
The detection type. Valid values:

0: Screen chat tool detection.
1: Candidate status detection
parameters.help_zh:
检测类型。

0：屏幕聊天工具检测
1：考生状态检测
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored on your on-premises machine or in an OSS bucket in another region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

ChatScore.description_en:
The probability that the screenshot contains chat tools. Valid values: (0, 1).
This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 0
ChatScore.description_zh:
屏幕截图包含聊天工具的概率，取值范围(0,1)。
当请求参数Type取值为0时显示该参数

FaceInfo.description_en: The face information of the central person. This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 1
FaceInfo.description_zh: 中心人物的人脸信息。当请求参数Type取值为1时显示该参数

Completeness.description_en: The face completeness score. Valid values: (0, 1)
Completeness.description_zh: 人脸完整度分数，取值范围(0,1)

FaceNumber.description_en: The number of detected faces. A value of 0 indicates that no candidate face is detected
FaceNumber.description_zh: 检测到的人脸人数，0代表未检测到考生人脸

Pose.description_en: The face pose. When the face is directly facing the camera, all three angles are 0. Valid values: -90 to 90 degrees
Pose.description_zh: 正对摄像机时3个角度都为0， 取值范围正负90度之间

Pitch.description_en: The pitch angle. A positive value indicates looking up, and a negative value indicates looking down
Pitch.description_zh: 上下俯仰角角度，抬头为正值，低头为负值

Roll.description_en: The roll angle. A positive value indicates a clockwise rotation in the image, and a negative value indicates a counterclockwise rotation
Roll.description_zh: 人脸在画面中顺时针转动为正值，逆时针转动为负值

Yaw.description_en: The yaw angle. A positive value indicates looking to the left, and a negative value indicates looking to the right
Yaw.description_zh: 向左看为正值，向右看为负值

PersonInfo.description_en: The attribute and behavior information of the central person. This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 1
PersonInfo.description_zh: 中心人物的属性行为信息。当请求参数Type取值为1时显示该参数

Score.description_en: The probability score of using a mobile phone. Valid values: (0, 1)
Score.description_zh: 打电话的概率分数，取值范围(0,1)

Threshold.description_en:
The recommended threshold.

This value is for reference only. In actual scenarios, select an appropriate Score threshold based on your testing results
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值。

仅作为参考，实际应用中根据测试情况选取合适的Score阈值即可

Score.description_en: The probability score of wearing headphones. Valid values: (0, 1)
Score.description_zh: 戴耳机的概率分数，取值范围(0,1)

Threshold.description_en:
The recommended threshold.

This value is for reference only. In actual scenarios, select an appropriate Score threshold based on your testing results
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值。

仅作为参考，实际应用中根据测试情况选取合适的Score阈值即可

PersonNumber.description_en: The total number of detected persons. A value of 0 indicates that no candidate is detected
PersonNumber.description_zh: 检测到的总人数，0代表未检测到考生

Threshold.description_en:
The recommended threshold. Valid values: (0, 1). If the ChatScore value is greater than the threshold, the system determines that the input screenshot contains chat tools.
This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 0
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值，取值范围(0,1)。当ChatScore大于阈值时，系统判定输入屏幕截图中包含聊天工具。
当请求参数Type取值为0时显示该参数
